title: Event: daemon_stopping
description: Pushed by the daemon to every client connection except plugins right before a controlled shutdown, so a client can tell a requested stop from a crash. Best-effort: the daemon sends it before closing the sockets, but a crash or a forced kill sends nothing, so a connection that closes without this event means the daemon went down unexpectedly. Plugins must exit when their connection closes.

reason.description: Why the daemon is stopping. 'user_quit': the user chose to quit KeyForge from the daemon's own UI (the tray's Quit); the GUI should close too. 'terminated': something outside the daemon asked it to stop (a termination signal, the service manager, the OS ending the session or shutting down, or a client stopping or restarting it); the GUI stays open. 'error': the daemon hit a fatal error it could still report before exiting; the GUI stays open.
